*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**People in [[Guam]] and the [[Northern Mariana Islands]] are told to seek refuge as [[Typhoon Mawar]] approaches with winds reaching 282 km/h (175mph). [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/490551/people-in-guam-marianas-told-to-seek-shelter-as-typhoon-approaches (RNZ)]
*The historic [[Cotton Tree (Sierra Leone)|Cotton Tree]], a large ''[[Ceiba pentandra]]'', is felled during a [[storm|rainstorm]] in [[Freetown]], [[Sierra Leone]]. [[President of Sierra Leone|President]] [[Julius Maada Bio]] calls the destruction of the iconic tree a "great loss to the nation". [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sierra-leone-loses-historic-tree-symbol-freedom-rainstorm-2023-05-25/ (Reuters)]
